text: Nate and Joanna caught up; Nate had a video game tournament setback. Joanna is lactose intolerant and bakes dairy-free desserts—chocolate, raspberry, coconut—including chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting. Nate advised using dairy-free margarine or coconut oil and checking labels. Joanna invited Nate to bake together; he agreed and offered help anytime.
